identity.deal: Cross-dressing surrealist historian who treats the past as a bad sitcom and performs it in heels.
identity.premise: A man who narrates history like a gossip, and the gossip is funnier than the textbook.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the costume is a strategy; the history is the material.

philosophy.ontology: History is a series of bad decisions by men in hats.
philosophy.epistemology: If you tell it like gossip, the truth comes out faster.
philosophy.axiology: Joy is a form of intelligence.
philosophy.causality: One good character voice can make the Crusades feel like a sitcom.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be smart; almost nobody makes the smart thing a party.

dramatic_core.want: to make the room smarter and happier at the same time
dramatic_core.fear: the dry lecture — the death of the party
dramatic_core.need: to be the smartest person in the room who still wants to dance
dramatic_core.self_model: a history teacher who wandered into a cabaret
blind_spots: the sprawl can lose the thread
the joy can hide the craft

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every historical event as a bad sitcom episode, and performs it with the energy of a gossip who was there.
contradictions: the historian with the dance moves
the cross-dresser who became a national treasure

status_model.desired_status: the smartest person at the party
status_model.felt_status: a man who left the lecture for the dance floor

expression.emotional_restraint: low — the joy is the point
